children: Overview
France dairy and specialty food producer's H1 sales rose 2.6%, driven by acquisitions
Current operating profit fell due to surplus milk supply and negative integration effects
Net income group share was nearly stable at €38 mln
Outlook
Company did not provide specific guidance for the current quarter or full year
Result Drivers
ACQUISITIONS BOOST REVENUE - Integration of SAVENCIA Gourmet Chocolate activities and acquisition of Quata in Brazil drove reported sales growth
WEAK DEMAND IN EUROPE - Cheese activities in Europe impacted by fragile consumption and pressure on purchasing power, reinforced by Middle East conflict
MILK SURPLUS AND INTEGRATION COSTS - Operating profit fell due to surplus milk supply, saturated demand, and negative effects from chocolate activities integration
